test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'SCOPE' is written as 'JZNMX' and 'GAMUT' is written as 'VBPHI'. How will 'RANGE' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b15de16d396b52c68424915920e099dae05b94ac6a08cd00b03ee850fcc8e27.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'SCOPE' is written as 'JZNMX'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c81c82d6ae538d68f7f7856d91c87d7d035eea3e362f75de66b46ae11c4d642d.png] 

'GAMUT' is written as 'VBPHI'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/79188e3460f7627b9e46a6958ef96c4c6aad296d024d421b7b6b105a0c2bf06e.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7df25163357c2d4dd0cda881bf78a0697598536513a7d61fef9ed865b5f276d7.png] 

Similarly, '**RANGE**' will be written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/72e0c1d265381c37c82a0654be63973bba5fc4a25b37c5120449fcf606a3a1de.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "**KBOVX**".
